title: Evidence record
description: One version of one source record as held in the evidence store. Records are immutable; a newer revision is a new record.

record_id.description: Stable identity of this record version, used in citations.

revision.description: Monotonic revision where the source has one (build number, ticket version, scan run); null for immutable identities such as commits.

valid_from.description: When this content version became true at the source.

observed_at.description: When the event or content change happened at the source.

confirmed_through.description: Time through which the current state was confirmed; freshness is measured from here. Null means freshness is unknown.

fetched_at.description: Acquisition time; never used for freshness.

writer.description: The single component authorised to write this source.

lineage.description: record_ids this record was derived from.

conflicts.description: record_ids that disagree with this one; attached on read.

superseded_by.description: Attached on read when a newer revision exists.

content_ref.description: Reference to the stored content blob.
